definitions: To discern or perceive something with difficulty.
To engage in sexual kissing and touching.
To write out or complete a document.
To pretend or claim something, often falsely.
examples: I could just make out a figure in the distance.
I can't make out what you're trying to say.
They were making out in the back of the cinema.
Please make out the cheque to 'Cash'.
He tried to make out that he was ill.
